statement: All twelve seven-point F.7 restriction maps have the same discrete kernel and the same completed kernel. The completed kernel meets every conjugate of each full source cusp Zhat trivially. The discrete kernel contains no nonidentity reducible mapping class in the specified index-twelve subgroup F13 of PΓ0,4.
depends_on: F.7, exact A4 cover and seven-point maps
manuscript_passages: Part F: nonsolvable finite centralizer comparison
notes: The exact map identity f_(hI)=r_h composed with f_I removes a common Mobius transformation. A primitive source cusp lifts a twist T^e to same-sign twists of exponent one; four retained labels detect one or two equal twists, so a Zhat character is injective on the cusp. The source kernel of A4 monodromy forces e to divide an arbitrary lifted twist exponent. Every seven-set meets V4 cosets in sizes 3,2,2. All84 subset-inertia four-point detectors are executed. F.9 refutes full injectivity by an exact rational Sturm and faithful Artin certificate and identifies the full36-fold kernel with the same nontrivial seven-point kernel. The A5 centralizer comparison remains Open in F.7. The earlier numerical braid exploration is not used as a proof.
